title: Gerente Financeiro
description:
Descrição

Você é apaixonado(a) por
números, mas entende que eles contam histórias?
Se para você finanças vai muito além de planilhas e balanços é sobre
estratégia, inteligência e impacto real esta é a sua oportunidade de fazer a
diferença.

Estamos
em busca de um(a) Gerente Financeiro(a) para transformar a área
financeira em um verdadeiro centro estratégico de inteligência dentro da
nossa associação de proteção veicular. Aqui, você terá autonomia para liderar,
inovar e construir processos sólidos que impulsionem nosso crescimento e
fortaleçam nossa sustentabilidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gerenciar fluxo de caixa ,
contas a pagar e receber, previsões financeiras e tesouraria. Elaborar e analisar demonstrativos
(DRE, balanço, relatórios de performance). Coordenar equipe financeira e
contábil, garantindo excelência operacional. Apoiar o planejamento estratégico
com dados financeiros sólidos e insights valiosos. Relacionar-se com bancos,
contadores e auditorias. Desenvolver estratégias de captação
de recursos e parcerias financeiras. Apoiar a diretoria na tomada de
decisões com análises de viabilidade e rentabilidade. Conduzir projetos de reestruturação
financeira e redução de custos. Implantar práticas de controladoria:
orçamento anual, controle orçamentário, apuração de custos, análise de
variações e ajustes estratégicos. Criar e monitorar indicadores
financeiros e operacionais que fortaleçam a governança corporativa. Garantir conformidade fiscal e
regulatória, alinhada às diretrizes da associação.

Requisitos e qualificações

·       
Graduação
completa em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. ·       
Mínimo
de 3 anos de experiência em liderança financeira. ·       
Excel
avançado e domínio de ERPs e ferramentas de BI. ·       
Perfil
analítico, organizado e colaborativo, com visão estratégica.

title: Supervisor Administrativo - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI BRASIL possui uma filial do Rio de Janeiro que operacionaliza e gerencia os projetos desenvolvidos em todo estado, sendo eles: Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição Rio, projetos com a concessionaria LIGHT (LIGHT RECICLAÇÃO e EXPOSIÇÃO), além de estar em fase de implantação de projeto em parceria com a PETROBRAS e algumas iniciativas em construção com alta probabilidade de se concretizar. Esses projetos abrangem os temas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda e programas financiados pela leis de incentivo fiscal. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO

Responsável pela administração da filial RJ, abrangendo contratos, aquisições, financeiro e recursos humanos, de modo a garantir o cumprimento das normas e diretrizes da AVSI, além de supervisionar a documentação jurídico-administrativa necessária para a execução dos projetos locais.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO
  • Dar suporte ao Gerente Geral para garantir a correta, pontual e diligente administração dos recursos da filial RJ;
  • Supervisionar e monitorar as atividades da equipe administrativa da filial, garantindo sua adequada interface com a Matriz;
  • Apoiar na gestão eficiente e transparente dos recursos dos projetos locais;
  • Garantir a correta aplicação das políticas, regras e procedimentos administrativos da organização nas áreas de aquisições, financeiro e recursos humanos;
  • Reportar-se aos coordenadores administrativos da matriz para garantir o alinhamento com as diretrizes organizacionais;
  • Enviar mensalmente, ao Setor Financeiro (matriz), o planejamento das contas a pagar da Filial;
  • Garantir o diálogo com o setor de Contabilidade (matriz) para lançamento de despesas e controle orçamentário das despesas locais;
  • Manter estreio alinhamento com o setor de RH (matriz), acompanhando as demandas de pessoal da filial, tais como admissões, férias, rescisões, entre outros, a fim de garantir o cumprimento de prazos e diretrizes legais;
  • Organizar e manter atualizada a documentação jurídico-administrativa necessária para a execução dos projetos;
  • Encaminhar solicitações e informações aos coordenadores administrativos conforme os processos internos da organização;
  • Atualizar, consolidar e zelar pela conservação dos bens e materiais do projeto, reportando as informações à matriz;
  • Preparar e submeter aos Gerentes de Projeto as ordens de pagamento, conforme procedimentos internos;
  • Reportar aos Gerentes de Projeto todas as questões relacionadas à administração do projeto, munindo de informações relevantes para a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Controlar a utilização e o abastecimentos dos veículos;
  • Controlar o uso de Taxi/UBER e demais despesas locais;
  • Executar serviços administrativos externos relacionados ao projeto, conforme demanda;
  • Manter interface com o sindicato local, quando necessário;
  • Acompanhar as auditorias administrativo-financeiras dos projetos, conforme demanda;
  • Controlar a jornada de trabalho da sua equipe mensalmente, acompanhando faltas, entregas de atestados, banco de horas e montagem de escala, se necessário;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento de férias da equipe em cumprimento das diretrizes legais, visando não haver prejuízo nas atividades do setor e buscando sempre que possível atender às solicitações dos funcionários;
  • Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos do setor, seguindo critérios definidos em protocolos e procedimentos, quando houver;
  • Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  • Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

Responsibilities

Análise de resultados: analisar os resultados das ações de merchandising e assiduidade da equipe de Promotores, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e propor ajustes nas estratégias.

Suporte aos Promotores: atuar como suporte aos Promotores, auxiliando na resolução de problemas e fornecendo informações sobre as estratégias de merchandising. Além disso, fornecer constantemente aos Promotores feedbacks construtivos para que os mesmos possam evoluir em suas atividades.

Relacionamento com varejistas: manter contato com os Encarregados de Seção e Gerentes de Lojas, garantindo uma boa relação comercial com os mesmos.

Sistemática: avaliação constante das sistemáticas de cada setor, afim de verificar se está sendo feita a melhor roteirização e se a mesma está sendo cumprida.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.

title: Research Fellow-4
description:
Overview

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Benefits
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
Salary Range

$45,000-$55,000

description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity.

For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here
  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.
Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do
  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships and broad based understanding around the needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, exchanges to drive partner led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how our AI-powered solution, Traffic Cop, solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.
Who You Are
  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.
Why Join Us
  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

title: Página da Vaga | Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Missão do cargo

Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades
  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação , realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais , atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs , analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1 , contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais , participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores , desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos , definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas , participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore , gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas , monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology) , avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações , realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.
Formação acadêmica
  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas)
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial
Experiência prévia desejada
  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation)
  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)
  • Normas e diretrizes de segurança operacional
  • Inglês avançado
Processo seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Ambiente de trabalho

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Executive Director of Strategic Transactions
description:
Overview

This executive leadership position is responsible for leading and directing complex real estate transactions from beginning to end for the capital asset portfolio. The incumbent will have oversight of a diverse portfolio and will work with the University and external partners to drive key objectives and optimize financial and mission-oriented performance of real estate transactions.

Must be able to organize and prioritize multiple tasks, effectively manage through stressful situations, and consistently make effective, high-quality decisions. Must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, service responsiveness and effectively manages business, regulatory agency, and internal and external relationships. This position will have overall responsibility for executing real estate transactions in conformity with the University’s strategic plan and with the approved Campus Master Plan.

Responsibilities
  • Formulates and executes strategies for long-range needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets. Source and identify real estate direct investment opportunities and joint venture/equity partners, and negotiate Letters of Intent and Term Sheets.
  • Coordinate pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third-party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Execute on the University’s strategic plan and initiatives approved by Senior Administration and Board of Trustees.
  • Prepare and present transaction analysis to Senior Administration and Board of Trustee regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc. Obtain all required Board of Trustee approvals and resolutions for real estate transaction.
  • Leads negotiations with investors and creditors, development partners, contractors, and vendors, ensuring that University policies are followed.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with University strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.
  • Prepare, direct, and negotiate purchase agreements, partnership agreements, lease agreements, and other legal transaction documents needed to close transactions.
  • Maintain copies of all University deeds, leases, and other real estate documents in a central database to allow management to respond to inquiries associated with real estate.
  • Act as coordinator and liaison to the University legal, risk management, environmental, health and safety departments for all real estate related activities.
  • Cultivate relationships with Community Associations, District Government agencies, and neighborhood groups to foster positive working relationships.
  • Prepare RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Coordinates with the Chief Financial Officer or designated committee regarding the evaluation, acceptance, management, and disposition of real property assets that are donated or bequeathed to the University.
  • Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.
  • Oversees development and review of periodic reports on finances and project performance to monitor the health of each project and the portfolio. Consults with Leadership in REDCAM, CFO, and Resident Life to prioritize work requirements.
  • Makes recommendations on processes, procedures, policies, methodologies, and metrics for managing, reviewing, measuring, and evaluating project and portfolio performance.
  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
Qualifications and Core Competencies
  • Comprehensive knowledge of real estate markets and trends.
  • Ability to conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions regionally and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University and local school officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop processes and procedures to successfully monitor and provide project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
  • Ability to establish and execute projects by establishing communication plans to identify initial needs or supplemental project resources.
  • Communicates with the University community, the public, and the media regarding planning, design, and construction issues is required; Management skills, particularly in decision-making, are required.
  • Gathers and thoroughly analyzes information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.
  • Independent, entrepreneurial, ability to create processes to accomplish and manage acquisitions.
  • Ability to manage multiple suppliers and strategic partner relationships.
  • Broad knowledge of the principles and practices in financial management required.
  • The ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.
  • Strong Organizational, Management, Presentation And Communication Skills Are Required. Superior people relationship skills are required.
  • Ability to plan and manage within budget and time constraints is required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Minimum Requirements
  • A Master’s Degree with a minimum of 10 years of work related experience.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Demonstrated experience as a management executive in real estate transactions.

description:

Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills And Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Promover e preservar a saúde dos colaboradores no ambiente de trabalho, por meio de ações de medicina preventiva, assistencial e ocupacional, conforme a legislação vigente e as normas da empresa.

Assessorar tecnicamente os setores da empresa quanto às ações de promoção e vigilância em saúde;

Apoiar a CIPA e demais comissões internas de saúde e segurança;

Trabalhar em conjunto com o Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho na identificação e mitigação de riscos à saúde;

Graduação completa em Medicina;

Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho (com título de especialista reconhecido pelo CRM);

title: Vessel Medic
description:
Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy’s future and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Doctor Degree in Medicine and registration with the Regional Medical Council (CRM).
  • Certifications in advanced life support, such as Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS).
  • Advanced English CBSP and HUET NR 32 and NR 37.
  • Minimum experience of 02 years in Emergency Medicine or Intensive Care.

Preferred Qualifications and Education:

  • Desirable offshore experience.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform initial diagnoses and treatments, stabilizing patients until they can be transferred to medical facilities on land, if necessary.
  • Implement disease prevention and health promotion programs.
  • Monitor and control outbreaks of infectious diseases on board.
  • Manage the stock of medicines and medical equipment, ensuring that they are always available and in good condition.
  • Keep detailed records of all care and procedures performed.
  • Train staff on first aid procedures and use of emergency equipment.
  • Conduct educational sessions on occupational health and safety.
  • Work with safety engineers, occupational safety technicians, and other professionals to ensure a safe work environment.
  • Participate in occupational health and safety meetings.
  • Ensure that all medical activities comply with regulatory standards, such as NR-30 and NR-37.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and training to the Nurse on medical and emergency procedures.
  • In emergency situations, the Doctor makes critical decisions and guides the Nurse in carrying out the necessary procedures.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Linux Devices Software Engineer
description:

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Linux Devices Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This role is one of our general tracks. Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels.

We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon.

Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices.

These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware.

But while classic, 'deb' based Ubuntu is ideal for developers, it has too much variability for appliance or connected device environments, where you want to know *exactly* what the state of millions or billions of devices might be. So Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices.

We have several teams that focus on open source for embedded environments. We hire outstanding Linux software engineers with a passion for open source, innovation, cutting-edge hardware and software technologies in general. You will be expected to make significant contributions through high-quality design and code, and to develop your technical leadership.

These roles include:

  • Ubuntu Core and snapd software development
  • Silicon software and optimisation engineers
  • Kernel driver and hardware enablement engineers
  • Hardware-centric Linux QA Engineers
  • Hardware Certification Engineers
  • Robotics engineers
  • Industrial IoT software engineers
  • Networking software engineers (switching, routing, access and SmartNICs)

At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu and Ubuntu Core across the widest range of devices.

Location: we have remote roles open in every time zone.

What your day will look like

Based on the first round of interviews we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit, and conduct second round interviews with those teams. Our engineers:

  • Work with the latest Linux kernel and open source technologies
  • Deliver Ubuntu for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms
  • Integrate and maintain device-oriented software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed software
  • Collaborate proactively with other globally distributed teams
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Help our customers ship their apps and SDKs on Ubuntu
  • Build device OS images with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Optimise the Ubuntu kernel and libraries for silicon-specific capabilities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Work usually from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Passion for Linux or embedded systems software (e.g. kernel, graphics, Yocto)
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience with firmware, uboot, UEFI, ACPI, DSDT, or boot loaders
  • Experience with power management on PCI ASPM, SATA ALPM, low power profiles
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V
  • Experience in board design, bring up, and validation
  • Experience with electrical engineering design tools (e.g. schematic capture, layout)
  • Familiarity with Ubuntu development model
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Shell or Python scripting skills

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are looking for candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior.

As part of the Ubuntu Security Team, you will work with some of the best and brightest people in technology to monitor, triage, respond to, and document new and existing vulnerabilities in open source software. You will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify issues, prioritize them, and coordinate remediation.

This is an engineering-focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.

This role requires international travel at least twice a year, usually for one week. It also requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

  • Keeping track of vulnerabilities in the Ubuntu ecosystem as they are discovered, researched, and fixed, leveraging internal tools

  • Auditing source code for vulnerabilities
  • Building features and tools to help teams strengthen the security of their products and contribute to the overall security of Ubuntu

You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges. In this role you will have the opportunity to influence team and security culture, facilitate technical delivery, and help drive team direction and execution. You'll collaborate closely with Canonical's kernel team as well as the wider engineering organization to drive features impacting all Ubuntu users.

  • Collaborate with other engineers in the Security Hardening team to achieve and retain various Security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components (OpenSSL, Libgcrypt, GnuTLS, and others) with the features and functionality required for FIPS and CC certification
  • Collaborate with external security consultants to test and validate kernel and crypto module components
  • Work with external partners to develop security hardening benchmarks and audit + remediation automation for Ubuntu

  • Hands-on experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting

  • Significant development experience working with open source libraries

title: Training Site Infrastructure Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

Key responsibilities
  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

Your profile

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

We are hiring a Web/UI Engineer to develop a data-rich and reliable user experience. These frontends are constructed using JS, CSS, React, and Flutter, and serve as Canonical's enterprise products that act as the company's face to our users.

We are excited to develop this further and see if we can help more open-source projects build performant and accessible interfaces that respond well to diverse layouts. We use REST APIs for communication, and we consider API design an important part of the process.

Flutter is a new front-end technology that has the potential to unify our desktop and web development. We are growing the team's exposure to Flutter and have roles on both web and Ubuntu engineering for this specialism.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Security role at Canonical

As the most widely used Linux distribution, Ubuntu underpins the security of the entire internet. The role of Security Engineering Manager directly impacts the safety and security of millions of users worldwide. Join a team of security experts dedicated to protecting the open-source ecosystem and driving innovation. Your leadership will be instrumental in addressing emerging threats, developing robust security measures, and ensuring the continued integrity of Ubuntu. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference and leave a lasting legacy on the digital landscape. The security engineering team's first responsibility is to respond to emerging threats and aim to secure the open source ecosystem for community and enterprise use. Your work will improve the security of millions of people, by addressing potential CVEs and vulnerabilities alongside the lifecycle of Canonical products such as Ubuntu. You will engage directly with our community and customers, as well as coordinating efforts across multiple engineering teams and projects to make this happen.

An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.

What you will do in this role

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Provide technical guidance on vulnerability remediation
  • Drive the development of new security engineering projects
  • Work with upstream open source projects on vulnerability lifecycle handling
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices

  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

  • A demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Optional things we value

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Join Howard University and thrive with us!

 />
Job Purpose

The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, synthesis, and characterization of novel nanomaterials for drug delivery applications, as well as the development of advanced chemical biology tools. This individual will be responsible for applying expertise in nanoparticle production, fluorescent labeling strategies for biomolecules, and robust bioconjugate synthesis to advance our pipeline of innovative therapeutics and diagnostics.

Supervisory Authority

This position may involve supervising undergraduate and graduate students.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include Jacqueline Smith. External contacts include N/A.

Principal Accountabilities

The Research Scientist will be responsible for the following.

  • Design, synthesize, and characterize various types of nanoparticles (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, inorganic nanoparticles) for targeted drug delivery, gene therapy, or diagnostic imaging applications.
  • Optimize nanoparticle formulation parameters (size, morphology, surface charge, drug loading, release kinetics) for desired in vitro and in vivo performance.
  • Develop and implement robust analytical methods for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, HPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy).
  • Evaluate the stability, biocompatibility, and efficacy of nanoparticle-based systems.
  • Develop and optimize strategies for site-specific and quantitative fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, antibodies, and other biomolecules.
  • Work with a variety of fluorescent dyes and fluorophores, including organic dyes, quantum dots, and fluorescent proteins.
  • Characterize labeled biomolecules for purity, integrity, and functionality using techniques such as gel electrophoresis, mass spectrometry, and fluorescence spectroscopy.
  • Design and execute synthetic routes for the efficient and reproducible conjugation of various molecules (e.g., drugs, targeting ligands, imaging agents) to nanoparticles, peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Utilize a range of bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., click chemistry, amide coupling, maleimide chemistry, hydrazone formation) to achieve desired conjugation outcomes.
  • Purify and characterize bioconjugates using appropriate chromatographic and spectroscopic methods.
  • Design and synthesize novel small molecules, linkers, and probes for various biological applications.
  • Presenting research findings at regular group meetings, as well as local and national conferences
  • Publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals

Core Competencies

  • Extensive hands-on experience with the synthesis, characterization, and application of various nanoparticle systems for drug delivery (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, micelles, dendrimers).
  • Proficiency in a wide range of analytical techniques for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, cryo-TEM, HPLC, FPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy, zeta potential).
  • Demonstrated expertise in diverse bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., EDC/NHS, maleimide-thiol, click chemistry, hydrazone, oxime ligations).
  • Proven ability to design and execute strategies for fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Strong background in organic synthesis and purification techniques (e.g., column chromatography, HPLC, LC-MS).
  • Solid understanding of biomolecular interactions and protein chemistry.
  • Proficiency in data analysis software and scientific literature databases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to scientific rigor.

Minimum Requirements

M.S. in Chemical Biology or Biochemistry and 1-2 years of experience or Ph.D. Chemical Biology or Biochemistry

O Gerente de Vendas será responsável por liderar a equipe comercial , definir estratégias agressivas de crescimento e garantir resultados consistentes em margem e receita . Seu papel é construir autoridade no mercado , dominar a concorrência e transformar previsões em números reais de faturamento.

Responsabilidades

Objetivo da Posição

O Gerente de Vendas será responsável por liderar a equipe comercial , definir estratégias agressivas de crescimento e garantir resultados consistentes em margem e receita . Seu papel é construir autoridade no mercado , dominar a concorrência e transformar previsões em números reais de faturamento.

Responsabilidades
  • Definir, executar e ajustar o plano estratégico de vendas alinhado aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe comercial, garantindo disciplina no uso de roteiros, metas e indicadores de performance.
  • Construir a tríplice confiança com clientes: confiança no produto, no vendedor e na decisão de compra.
  • Elaborar e otimizar ofertas irresistíveis que aumentem o valor percebido e reduzam o risco para o cliente.
  • Usar técnicas avançadas de negociação: perguntas estratégicas, “ponte ao futuro” e quebra de objeções .
  • Monitorar resultados, pipeline e previsões comerciais, tomando decisões rápidas para corrigir desvios.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico do cliente , garantindo recorrência e fidelização de longo prazo.
Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Atingimento e superação de metas mensais e trimestrais.
  • Crescimento percentual em receita e margem.
  • Redução do ciclo de vendas.
  • Retenção e satisfação de clientes-chave.
  • Desenvolvimento de novos líderes dentro da equipe.
Perfil do Candidato
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes comerciais e vendas de alto valor.
  • Habilidade para negociar em cenários complexos , com múltiplos decisores.
  • Mentalidade de líder e estrategista , não apenas executor.
  • Capacidade de motivar e disciplinar times , blindando-os contra distrações e baixa performance.
  • Domínio de técnicas de vendas consultivas e habilidade de construir rapport genuíno.
  • Foco em lucro, margem e posicionamento de mercado .
Diferenciais
  • Histórico de crescimento acelerado em empresas B2B ou B2C.
  • Experiência em estruturar ofertas de alto impacto (ex: “resultado ou dinheiro de volta”).
  • Vivência em programas de treinamento e mentoria de vendas .
  • Capacidade de transformar objeções em novas oportunidades de fechamento .
Remuneração & Benefícios
  • Salário fixo competitivo.
  • Comissão agressiva baseada em performance.
  • Bônus por superação de metas.
  • Resumo: Esta vaga não é para quem busca estabilidade e rotina previsível. É para quem quer liderar com estratégia, cortar desculpas, cobrar resultados e colocar a empresa no topo do mercado .

title: Analista de Tecnologia da Informação
description:
Analista de Tecnologia da Informação - Pleno

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Tecnologia da Informação para se juntar ao nosso time na Auto Park.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência em suporte técnico, sistemas de informação, hardware e software, segurança da informação, redes de computadores e metodologias de desenvolvimento.

Como Analista de TI, você será responsável por garantir a segurança e a eficiência dos sistemas de informação da empresa. Seu papel será crucial para o suporte diário, a implementação de novas tecnologias e a manutenção de um ambiente de TI seguro e funcional.

Experiência em suporte técnico é essencial, pois você será o ponto de contato para questões de hardware e software, garantindo que os problemas sejam resolvidos de forma rápida e eficiente. Além disso, é necessário um profundo conhecimento em segurança da informação para proteger os dados da empresa e mitigar riscos potenciais.

Sua expertise em redes de computadores será vital para a manutenção e otimização das conexões internas e externas da empresa. Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil ou outras práticas de desenvolvimento são altamente valorizadas, pois ajudarão a otimizar processos e a garantir a entrega de projetos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Se você é um profissional dedicado e tem um histórico comprovado em tecnologia da informação, esta é uma oportunidade para se destacar e contribuir para o sucesso da Auto Park. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe inovadora e dinâmica.

Sobre a Empresa

A Autopark iniciou suas atividades em Curitiba e atualmente é uma das cinco mais conceituadas redes brasileiras de estacionamentos.

Administra mais de 100 unidades com aproximadamente 50 mil vagas, localizadas nos Estados de Minas Gerais, Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Rio Grande do Sul.

O plano de expansão prevê atuação em outras cidades e Estados do país.

A Autopark oferece soluções em consultoria, operação e administração em modalidades de estacionamentos privados, como condomínios comerciais, hotéis, universidades, shoppings, hospitais, clínicas, aeroportos, centros esportivos, centros de comércio e serviços.

A empresa desenvolve práticas customizadas para cada perfil de empreendimento, voltadas para atendimento com qualidade e eficiência. Seus principais pontos fortes incluem pioneirismo, tradição, qualidade e credibilidade, além de investir cada vez mais em Tecnologia da Informação (TI), incentivando a utilização de equipamentos automatizados nos estacionamentos.

Todos esses esforços garantem serviços de qualidade para parceiros e clientes, além de melhores resultados para os empreendimentos.

description:
